decision: opened the JIT audit on the userspace-jit commit
why: the task names that commit as the review baseline
result: open

decision: ran the existing JIT tests before edits
why: a later failure has to be separable from the starting tree
evidence: cargo test in jit/, 5 unit tests and 14 exec tests
result: tests green

decision: reject a bad lddw second word, a branch into that word, an unknown ALU opcode, and a BPF-to-BPF call
why: those inputs used to be accepted or could panic
result: tests green

decision: helper calls use the ilp32 dispatcher shape and link refuses a zero or missing address
why: the firmware function is helper_dispatcher(idx, a1..a5), not the Linux RV32 pair calling convention
result: array lookup test green

decision: select xdp or xdp1 instead of the empty .text section
why: Clang marks an empty .text executable, so the first pass compiled zero instructions
result: div2 r0 0x4

decision: lower half and word memory ops as bytes
why: case_mark stored a u32 at packet offset 0x1e and the RV interpreter rejected the misaligned sw
result: case_mark r0 0x3

decision: did not flash the DUT
why: flash_xdp only builds a named AOT profile, and bsort is larger than the firmware slot
result: INCONCLUSIVE

decision: both engines faulting is recorded as inconclusive, not pass
why: the two interpreters share one memory limit, so a shared bound makes them fault together; calling that pass hides a register or memory disagreement
result: tests green

decision: check_packet writes a MAP1 descriptor per map and watches its storage
why: the CLI path never wrote one, so a helper lookup always missed and the map path was never compared
result: xdp_drop and firewall still r0 0x2, now with a writable map

decision: host helper address corrected to 0x4038_0000
why: the firmware contract has it at 0x4038_0000; 0x4038_1000 came from an encoder test fixture
result: open on the board: the address is still untested there

decision: patch_lddw checks the unlinked lui/addi shape before swapping in the address
why: the ABI note promised that a half-written relocation is not executable, but only the call path checked anything
result: tests green

decision: kept ALU END imm=64 and fixed the reference instead
why: RFC 9669 section 4.2 defines the 64-bit swap for the ALU class, and bitswap lowers to be64; the reference was truncating to 32 bits
result: bitswap pass r0 0x2

decision: check-xdp.sh finds PREVAIL by itself and an inconclusive run is not a pass
why: a reviewer running the script as written hit the empty submodule directory
result: report.tsv reproduced without env overrides except CLANG

decision: picked up the Cursor run on agent/jit-xpost-verify and redid none of it
why: the prior trail is authoritative; rows 2026-11-12T09:42Z..19:40Z were written by that run, not this one
evidence: this run: T3 poteto-delivery session; git 4f1fbd7
result: resume point named: P2 oracle independence

decision: re-ran the inherited suite and pipeline myself before trusting them
why: a prior self-report is not proof
evidence: cargo test 11 unit + 17 exec green; jit/scripts/check-xdp.sh reproduced report.tsv identically
result: inherited P0/P1 claims hold

decision: swapped the hand-written reference for the rbpf fork as an independent oracle
why: bpf_vm.rs was written in the same change as the JIT and shared its premises, so agreement proved nothing
evidence: jit/oracle/, rbpf at /Volumes/SSD/bs/xpost/rbpf builds on aarch64-apple-darwin
result: 8727 cases, found a real defect the old pair could not see

decision: map identity comes from the ELF relocation, not insn.src
why: Clang leaves src_reg 0 and names the map only in the relocation, so testing src alone loaded constant 0 and every lookup missed while both engines agreed
evidence: llvm-readelf -r xdp_drop.bpf.o reloc 0x70 R_BPF_64_64 blocklist; compile.rs:400; exec.rs clang_map_lddw_resolves_through_the_relocation
result: fixed; map programs went relocs 1 to 2; program suite 14/14

decision: kept the JIT ALU32 mod-by-zero behavior and attributed the divergence to rbpf
why: rbpf zero-extends ALU32 mod with a nonzero divisor but not with a zero divisor, which is inconsistent with itself
evidence: oracle probes alu32/mod/x/0xffffffffffffffff/0x1 pass vs /0x0 fail; jit/oracle/examples/modzero.rs 15/15
result: JIT judged correct; RFC clause text unverified, both official RFC hosts blocked

decision: restored the sibling xpost layout with a symlink above the worktree
why: tools and the build scripts resolve ../../xpost, which a worktree breaks
result: existing packer builds in the worktree

decision: put the link-and-pack step in tools, not in the jit crate
why: tools already had the XPM1 reader, the bpf.toml metadata builder and xpost-elf, so the jit stays dependency-free and no container logic is duplicated
result: 7 containers accepted by the loader's own scan_at; bsort refused at 12956 vs 3584

decision: ran JIT containers on the ESP32-C3 RX path with AOT controls
why: host acceptance is not execution; the task's acceptance gate is the real datapath
evidence: jit/reports/p4/summary.tsv; 6 programs, safety counters all zero; hot-switch ok=1 rollback=0
result: OBSERVED; packet-byte capture INCONCLUSIVE without root tcpdump

decision: verified the flashed container is byte-identical to a fresh pack-jit run
why: a device result is only attributable to the JIT if the image really came from it
result: IDENTICAL

decision: led with the firmware batch mean, not the single-shot engine segment
why: the single-shot median is flat near 70us across workloads differing 20x in work, so it measures per-call overhead rather than the program
evidence: jit/reports/p5/matrix/summary.tsv 80 records; AOT incr 5363ns probe vs 5362ns matrix
result: JIT 1.12-1.65x AOT; rBPF 8-70x AOT; HAL fastest

decision: reported rBPF helper cost as NOT MEASURED instead of quoting a number
why: the cold switch path never resolves the map index, so its 122us batch measures 8 null lookups, not 8 real ones
result: gap reported against xpost, not patched

decision: kept the PR Draft and wrote the gaps down instead of claiming full acceptance
why: packet bytes on silicon, the RFC clause text, stack depth and rBPF helper cost are all still open
result: core goal met on silicon; 8 gaps recorded

decision: corrected the report after an artifact review found real overclaims
why: the reviewer read the artifacts rather than the narrative and caught errors I had shipped
evidence: jit/REPORT.md sections 3 5 6 8; .audit rows C2 C4 R6 R43 R53 A-P2
result: supersedes rows 24 and 26

decision: HAL is not a comparable arm and no engine-only ratio is claimed
why: invoke_batch brackets the whole ingress flight path while the HAL bench brackets only run_hal, so the 1.16us vs 5.36us gap is a difference in what was timed
result: R53 downgraded to partial; JIT/AOT labelled a floor

decision: closed the RFC gap by reading the IETF WG source instead of accepting blocked
why: the published RFC hosts are blocked but the RFC body text is in the WG repo on GitHub, which is reachable
evidence: ietf-wg-bpf/ebpf-docs rst/instruction-set.rst: for ALU the upper 32 bits of the destination register are zeroed
result: mod-by-zero adjudication now spec-confirmed; also confirms F3 and F4

decision: restated the oracle disagreement count as 111, not 27
why: 84 real engine disagreements were sitting inside the unsupported bucket, so the top line understated them
evidence: jit/oracle/results.json counted directly: 6688 probes, 44 JMP64-imm and 40 SDIV/SMOD disagreements
result: counts corrected in REPORT and audit

decision: withdrew the per-source counting claim for case_mark and just_tx
why: rxcnt[17] is not a per-source key and those windows are background-dominated; counter[96] was +31 for 30 sent, not exact
result: action split and bad_md=0 remain the evidence; totals withdrawn

decision: downgraded hot-switch to a state-machine result
why: p4_switch.py sends no stimulus and all four steps finish inside 103ms, so no packet ran through a slot after a switch
result: R43 partial; post-switch datapath recorded as unverified

decision: committed the build reports the audit cited
why: build/ is gitignored, so eight evidence rows pointed at paths a reviewer could not open
evidence: jit/reports/build/ holds both report.tsv files and every pack-jit stderr line
